findings.text: Dành chỗ cho những từ mới.
findings.msg: the first screen holds no number, price, date, place, platform or genre
findings.fix: put one hard fact from the brief on the first screen: a number, a price, a date, the place, the platforms it runs on or a game's genre; take it from the brief or remove the claim

findings.msg: "Đăng nhập →" does not start with a verb (book, buy, try, start, get, see...)
findings.fix: label buttons with a verb and what the visitor gets ("Book a room", "Start free trial")

findings.msg: a software page (--type) deals no moment: every kind carries one, two on a long page (moments.md)

findings.msg: the first Tab stop is "wordwiseTIẾNG ANH MỖI NGÀY", not a skip link: a keyboard user tabs through the whole nav on every visit

findings.msg: the head lacks og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card, an icon, theme-color: a shared link shows no picture or title of its own
findings.fix: copy the head block of starter.html: og tags, twitter:card, the icon and theme-color (references/system.md, Head)

findings.msg: the form has no status line (role="status"): sending, sent and errors are never read out
findings.fix: give each field its type, autocomplete and inputmode, never block paste or disable the button before a submit, and add the status line (references/system.md, Forms)
